title: Ask the Currency page a question
items: Eight buttons over the Currency grid ask what a thing does instead of what its price did: changes an item, guarantees a modifier, sockets in and stays, adds quality, desecrates, opens a door, becomes a gem, supports a skill. Pick one and the groups under it narrow to match.

Orb cards now show the whole upgrade ladder: what each step asks today, and the lowest modifier level it guarantees. The game says the same sentence on all three, so nothing told you what the upgrade bought.
Runes, soul cores and idols read as a table — the slot on the left, what it gives there on the right — instead of one run-on line.
The crafting bench is one press from any currency card that can reach it.
The bench is one screen. Rolling no longer sends you to a second card, the drawer keeps your materials in hand, and you can bring more currency in in the middle of a craft.
The bench has a search box. It searches every shelf at once, and Ctrl + / lands in it.
The busiest exchange markets now wear their art, both ends of every pair.
The Currency page leads with the currency. The busiest exchange markets moved below the grid, and the price buttons became one list beside the sort, so the cards start on the first screen.
A market says what it is priced in, so one currency's two markets no longer read as the same row twice.

title: Worth it
items: Bosses now say whether a kill is worth it: what the way in costs, what the kill returns as a range, and how many kills before that range means anything.
3,819 places the game's own wording points at an interaction are mapped. 516 open a card; the rest are marked unclear, beside what players report.
Pin any card. The list stays while the tab is open.
Base items carry a price.
Price charts reach back through past leagues, from poe.ninja, marked with theirs.
Search leans toward the kinds of card you have been opening.
Build and Farms are closed for rebuilding. Farms comes back as your own farm: what you put in, what you got out, counted over your runs.

title: The crafting bench
items: The crafting bench: pick a base, pick your currency and omens, and practise the craft. Every roll comes off the real pool, with how often each one lands named where it is shown. A craft you leave is still there after a refresh.
Every card you can craft with carries a way to the bench: bases, orbs, essences, omens, runes, catalysts and bones.
A base card now says what it can roll and what a corruption can add. Gloves carry a Stonefist switch.
Trade: pick a base and the mods, the defence types and the sliders narrow to what that base can have. One tap clears it.
Item classes are cards of their own: Gloves, Boots, Quarterstaves and 28 more, each with every base under it.
32 more keyword cards, and every keyword card now says what uses it.
Still levelling? The Build tab links a community campaign guide by domistae.
How damage works and how defences work are now a sword and a shield beside the name, instead of two blocks across the card.

title: Every card, connected
items: Bosses: 104 of them, what they drop, and the live price of the way in. Rates where a real sample exists, with the source named.
Cards remember where you have been: back and forward through 50 steps, with hotkeys, and a card comes back exactly as you left it.
Words in a card's lines now open their own card. 21,324 of them across 5,500 cards.
Essences say what they add on each kind of item.
Craft: how often each mod rolls on a base, likeliest first.
Currency: search all 661 and star any of them, grouped by family.
893 small passives and every conqueror are searchable.
New mechanics cards: how damage works, with the order it is worked out in.
Price charts show this league and the three before it, each past league dashed in its own colour.
Cards fit a phone properly, and nothing scrolls sideways.

title: Cards that stay put
items: Cards no longer close when you tap, drag or select text inside them.
On a phone the card fills the screen, so there is far less dead space to mis-tap.
Escape while typing clears the box instead of closing the card.
Cleaner card text: 197 leftover lines of game code removed from unique items.
Page notes rewritten in plain English.

title: Faster
items: Search, Gems, Uniques and Passive tree open much quicker.
Repeat visits open instantly.
Nothing jumps around while a page loads.
Trade prices fill in every hour again.

title: The whole game in one search
items: New menu: two groups with small icons. Search, Build, Trade, Farms, then Craft, Currency, Passive tree, Uniques, Gems, Atlas.
Every base item (1,554 weapons, armour pieces, jewellery, jewels, flasks and charms) now has a card, with Trade and Open in Craft.
Atlas passives, waystones, tablets and keys are in the search too.
Keyword cards now list bases and essences.
Lineage gems are marked Lineage.
New Privacy page.

title: Real prices only
items: Currency prices come straight from the in-game Currency Exchange, every hour.
Unique prices come from live trade site listings, with when they were checked.
The Currency tab shows the busiest exchange markets.
Farms no longer shows a cost total: the sheet has no amounts, so there is no real one.
Keyword cards list everything that uses them, in order: uniques, gems, every passive, atlas, crafting mods, currency and keywords.

title: Keywords and Crafting
items: Every keyword shows what uses it: uniques, gems, passives, atlas and currency.
Gems, Uniques and Passive tree rows open full cards with Trade and prices.
New Craft tab: every mod a base can roll, and what each crafting method adds.

title: Live prices, Farms and Atlas
items: Trade sliders show what rolls really cost, updated every hour.
New Farms and Atlas tabs.
League countdown on the home page.
Popular searches, a Suggest button and faster pages.
Build tab reads Mobalytics links.

title: New look
items: Forged bronze frames, like the crest.
Tier marks on every trade slider.
Armour, Evasion and Energy Shield boxes for gear.

title: Keys and art
items: Keybindings: press ?. Ctrl + / searches the list you are on.
Game art on every card.

title: Trade in plain words
items: A Trade page that speaks human.
A Trade button on every card.

title: Our own home
items: wraeclastindex.fyi, the poison theme and a search box on every page.

title: The beginning
items: Every gem, unique and passive, straight from the game files.
